Generated Narrative: CodeSystem breathing-state-classification

This case-sensitive code system https://fhir.dha.go.ke/ig/patient-summary/CodeSystem/breathing-state-classification defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
CRITICAL-BRADYPNEA Critical BradypneaCritically low respiratory rate.
MILD-BRADYPNEA Mild BradypneaMildly reduced respiratory rate.
NORMAL NormalRespiratory rate within the normal range.
MILD-TACHYPNEA Mild TachypneaMildly elevated respiratory rate.
TACHYPNEA TachypneaElevated respiratory rate.
